item.title: US beats Canada 2-1 in overtime to win first men's hockey championship at the Olympics since 1980
item.description: The U.S. beat Canada 2-1 in overtime to win its first men's hockey championship at the Olympics since 1980.

item.title: NFL receiver Rondale Moore found dead in his Indiana hometown
item.description: NFL receiver Rondale Moore was found dead Saturday, authorities said. He was 25.

item.title: North Carolina man shot, killed by Secret Service and local deputy outside of Mar-a-Lago
item.description: The man was identified as 21-year-old Austin Tucker Martin from Moore County, North Carolina.

item.title: 2 separate fatal ski incidents reported at Heavenly resort in South Lake Tahoe, sheriff says
item.description: The Douglas County Sheriff's Office reported two fatal ski incidents at the Heavenly Mountain Resort on Friday, following a series of deadly ski incidents in the Lake Tahoe area.

item.title: San Francisco's Eileen Gu wins 6th Olympic medal; later learns her grandmother died
item.description: San Francisco born Eileen Gu won a gold and two silvers competing for China in freestyle skiing, defending her Olympic halfpipe title. But not long after the victory gave her a record-breaking third Olympic gold medal in freeskiing, Gu learned her grandmother, Guozhen Feng, had died.

item.title: Mexican army kills leader of powerful Jalisco New Generation Cartel, 'El Mencho,' during operation
item.description: Videos show plumes of smoke over the city of Puerto Vallarta and travelers sprinting through the airport of the state's capital in panic.

item.title: DHS suspends Global Entry as partial government shutdown drags on; PreCheck still operational
item.description: DHS said Sunday that the Global Entry program would be shut down as long as the partial government shutdown continues. It comes after the department said it planned to shut down TSA PreCheck as well, but DHS later canceled the PreCheck closure.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Mild temperatures tomorrow, chance of showers in North Bay
item.description: Tomorrow's afternoon highs will be milder in the mid-60s, with a chance of showers arriving in the late evening in the North Bay.

item.title: Flight cancellations snowball at San Francisco Airport due to Northeast blizzard
item.description: Flight cancellations were piling up at San Francisco International Airport on Sunday as a major blizzard clobbers the Northeast, shutting down airports and making travel treacherous.

item.title: BART halts service through Transbay Tube due to loss of communication, agency says
item.description: BART service through the Transbay Tube remained stopped due to a loss of communications through Sunday evening, the transit agency said. Riders were encouraged to take a dedicated A/C Transit shuttle as an alternative.
